constraints: Used with Print form (in the On Printing Detail form event) to force page breaks and print the last page built in memory; do not use with PRINT SELECTION (use Subtotal or BREAK LEVEL's optional parameter instead).
The '*' and '>' forms are mutually exclusive alternatives, not combinable in a single call.
When the user clicks Cancel in the screen print preview dialog box, PAGE BREAK sets the system variable OK to 0.

overloadMerges.semanticRole: Cancels the print job started with Print form, immediately stopping the print job in progress (most effective when the printer's 'Start printing after last page is spooled' property is set).
overloadMerges.note: No structural change; kept as the '*' form so its semanticRole/mechanism can be documented distinctly from the '>' form.

params.description: Continue-and-prioritize flag: holds the print job open (until PAGE BREAK is called again with no parameter) and gives it priority over other printing, guaranteeing the job spools to a single file.

overloadMerges.semanticRole: Holds the current print job open and gives it exclusive priority (no other printing can occur) until PAGE BREAK is called again without a parameter, so the whole job spools to one file.
overloadMerges.note: autoparse could not tokenize the non-identifier '>' parameter name from the 'PAGE BREAK ({>:>})' signature line and produced an empty-params overload; restored the '>' literal-symbol parameter for this doc syntax line.
